R scripting required run fit, every step engine also exported ordinary R function, pipeline works shell command, scripted R session, anywhere .

title: Beginner-Friendly Command-Line Front-End for imuGAP
text: Two input modes. Point imurun directory observations, populations, locations files (CSV RDS, CSV taking precedence), single .xlsx workbook one sheet per input — convenient people work R. Bundled template example workbooks. imurun init drops blank template (correct headers plus instructions sheet) directory; imurun example drops small, complete, runnable example derived imuGAP’s *_sim data. Friendly validation. Inputs checked canonical schema ([IMURUN_SCHEMA]) via layer imuGAP’s canonicalizers names offending sheet, column, row collects every problem can find rather stopping first. Validate-mode. imurun -h <input> checks inputs without fitting, can confirm workbook well-formed committing model run. Fits saves. success runs imuGAP::sampling() writes fit.rds (raw stanfit object) output directory post-processing. Scriptable. engine functions (run_fit(), read_inputs(), validate_inputs(), read_workbook(), friends) exported use directly R, CLI returns shell exit codes (0 success, 1 validation, 2 model, 3 /O) use pipelines.

Canonical imuGAP input schema — IMURUN_SCHEMA
text: column schema imurun targets two inputs. imurun simplifies imuGAP's inputs: rather separate populations sheet, observation row carries loc_id/cohort/age/dose, imurun constructs imuGAP populations observations (one weight = 1 row per observation). trades imuGAP's multi-row weighted populations simpler one-sheet input; future version may add optional populations sheet pure expansion. Extra columns permitted ignored; required columns enforced. element IMURUN_SCHEMA describes one sheet/input: observations One row per observation. Required columns: obs_id (unique non-missing identifier), loc_id (must exist locations), cohort (positive integer), age (positive integer), dose (integer 1:max_dose), positive (non-negative integer count positive results), sample_n (positive integer sample size, positive <= sample_n). Optional: censored (NA 1). locations location hierarchy. Required columns: loc_id (unique identifier), parent_id (parent's loc_id, NA single root).

what: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
title: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
text: core engine behind imurun command-line interface, exposed ordinary R function. Given directory inputs loads observations locations files (CSV RDS), validates canonical 'imuGAP' schema, fits model imuGAP::sampling(), writes fit.rds output directory. function never throws expected failure modes; instead prints human-readable message returns integer exit code, can drive shell command directly. exit-code taxonomy : 0 Success (usage/validation-request). 1 Schema validation failed. 2 Model fitting failed. 3 Input/output error (missing directory, unreadable unwritable files).

title: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
text: args character vector command-line style arguments. first non-flag argument input directory; optional second output directory (defaults input directory). leading -h/--help either prints usage (alone) requests validation-mode (followed input directory).

title: Run the imurun fitting pipeline — run_fit
code: # Usage text, no fitting: run_fit(character(0)) #> imurun.R -- Minimal CLI for imuGAP model fitting #>  #> Usage: imurun <input> [output_dir] #>        imurun -h <input>              (validate only, no model fitting) #>        imurun init [dir]              (write a blank input template workbook) #>        imurun example [dir]           (write a filled example workbook) #>        imurun -h | --help             (show this message) #>  #> <input> is either a directory of CSV/RDS files or a single .xlsx workbook. #>  #> A directory must contain: #>   observations.csv (or .rds)      -- columns: obs_id, loc_id, cohort, age, dose, positive, sample_n #>   locations.csv (or .rds)         -- columns: loc_id, parent_id (hierarchical; see package docs) #>  #> A workbook must have one sheet per input with the same column names #> (run 'imurun init' to get a correctly-headed template). #>  #> Output: fit.rds (raw stanfit object for post-processing). #> output_dir defaults to input_dir. Exit codes: 0=success, 1=validation, 2=model, 3=I/O.  # Validate inputs only (no Stan toolchain required): dir <- tempfile("imurun_validate_") dir.create(dir) if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Fit and write fit.rds (requires a working Stan toolchain): run_fit("path/to/inputs") } # }

title: imurun 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Exported core CLI engine ordinary R functions: run_fit(), read_inputs(), load_by_ext(), find_input_file(), check_all_inputs(). Added install_cli() put bundled imurun command PATH. Added .xlsx workbook input mode: read_inputs() now accepts either directory CSV/RDS files single workbook one sheet per input, via new read_workbook(). Missing sheets reported . Pinned canonical input schema IMURUN_SCHEMA shipped blank template workbook (inst/templates/imurun_template.xlsx) plus small filled example (inst/extdata/imurun_example.xlsx) derived imuGAP’s *_sim data; resolve imurun_template() / imurun_example(). Added imurun_init() imurun_copy_example() (imurun init / imurun example subcommands) scaffold workbooks directory. Added validate_inputs(), friendly validation layer imuGAP canonicalizers reports every problem spreadsheet terms. Set development infrastructure: R CMD check, lint, test coverage, pkgdown, spelling continuous-integration workflows.
